exempt.PousCheck.SetupDifftestMain: the setup difftest against the Python reference, under `runs`: compiled evaluation of PousCheck.SetupDifftest.main, audited under PousCheck, a test and not a proof
exempt.PousCheck.DifftestMain: the difftest against the Python verifier, under `runs`: compiled evaluation of PousCheck.Difftest.main, audited under PousCheck, a test and not a proof

PousCheck.DifftestMain.why: generated instances on which PousCheck's definitions give what the Python verifier gives: the verification tree (reference.leaf, verifier.leaf_hash, root, path, wire.path_length, verify_path on honest and tampered paths)

PousCheck.SetupDifftestMain.why: generated instances on which PousCheck's P2 v4 maps (d, σ, D), keys (expand_prefix, sha512_keys), commitment (setup.commit, tagged_sha512, the manifest) and public-encoder setup check (decode_segment, verifier_key mode PUBLIC, refusals by kind) give what the Python reference gives, and the spec's §7 vectors.json against its SHA-512 pins, keys, codewords and σ rejection cases

PousCheck.why: the program is code: Lean core and Flock's executable primitives only, no Mathlib and nothing of Security (Daniel's layout ruling, 5 Oct)
